description.p: Skribisto is geared toward helping anyone write anything, be it a novel or course notes. The user is free to use tags to define texts or write hundreds of notes. The tools are designed to be most unobtrusive, so you can write, write and write a bit more without too much distraction.

ul.li: Skribisto has been rewritten from scratch in Rust, with a new interface
New project format: a .skrib bundle holding plain-text prose, kept as a single file or as a folder you can put under version control
Projects from Skribisto 2.x are upgraded automatically when you open them
Write prose and its synopsis side by side, in split panes and tabs
Read a whole chapter, part or book as one continuous document, or all synopses at once
Corkboard, writing sessions, live word count and pace tracking
Search and replace across the whole project
Backups with a retention policy, several destinations, a scheduler, and read-only opening
Export to plain text, Markdown, HTML, DOCX, EPUB and PDF
Light and dark themes, and per-editor typography
Open several projects side by side, each in its own window
